answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate an identity polynomial whose committed coefficients are bound to a Semaphore tree and RLN rate limit. Each valid message carries a zero-knowledge membership proof and polynomial share; duplicate messages under one identity expose distinct shares, enabling Shamir reconstruction of the registered private key and immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. The reef, sable, and river test cases therefore offer no sybil escape.
